sections.overall:
First of all, our deepest condolences go out to PAC and his loved ones. He was a phenomenal wrestler, crucial to AEW's success, especially in the early days and he will be much missed. RIP PAC and thank you for being a wonderful, wrestler and person. 

All Out '26 was a mixed show, still positive overall (8.09), but was let down somewhat by an overbooked main event. Best match of the night, and the week, was New Level & Strickland vs Brodido & Page (9.25). A real showcase of the now-stellar Trios division and huge gains made by all six men, the two Tag and Trios teams, as a result.
sections.mens: We were treated to the International Title match of Kazuchika Okada vs Tommaso Ciampa (8.66). Despite the rushed build, it was a well-told story, including Ciampa's daughter flipping the bird! Unfortunately the main event was well-below expectations: as shown in the points drops for both Will Ospreay and Jon Moxley. Ospreay will have to wait longer to reclaim #1 and try to beat his peak rating set back at the end of 2024.
sections.womens: With four singles Women's matches across the week, all of them with a similar rating. Persephone pulled double duty, with a match on each Dynamite and All Out, though neither gained her many points. Thekla vs Willow Nightingale was a fun match (6.6) but below the expectations of two highly-rated wrestlers, causing a drop in points (but not ranking places at least) for both. Also, Kris Statlander drops out this week after 6 weeks of inactivity. We hope she returns soon!
sections.menstag: As predicted, the 3 Way Ladder Match absolutely rocked! Absolute, delicious carnage and the best from Cage & Copeland so far (8.92). Hats off to The Young Bucks and FTR for orchestrating such a masterpiece, alongside the now-ex champs. Also, our thoughts go out to Steven Borden, who had a nasty, unexpected injury during his PPV debut. The good news is that he seems to be stable, and hopefully will recover well.
sections.womenstag: It took a while, but finally the Women's Tag division has a match to be truly proud of! The Brawling Birds vs Divine Dominion delivered on all cylinders (8.22) and has set a new bar for the best match in the division's short history, as well as each team's ratings.. Barbed wire boards, thumbtacks, chairs... the Chicago Street Fight really delivered. Excellent work from all four women and big gains in both their individual and team ratings.
sections.trios: Weeks and weeks of rebuilding this division have really paid off, culminating in the best Trios match in history; yes, even higher than The Elite vs Death Triangle glory days! A special mention for the champions, who also had a great match against The Demand on Dynamite. We really hope that AEW continues this effort with the division as it has led to so many great matches and utilisation of plenty of talented wrestlers.
